sloka: अनार्य जुष्टम् अस्वर्ग्यम् कुर्याम् पापम् अहम् यदि ।इक्ष्वाकूणाम् अहम् लोके भवेयम् कुल पाम्सनः ॥२-८२-१४॥
transliteration: anārya juṣṭam asvargyam kuryām pāpam aham yadi ।ikṣvākūṇām aham loke bhaveyam kula pāmsanaḥ ॥2-82-14॥

translations.english: If I commit this evil act followed by wretched people which would not lead any one to heaven, I shall only be bringing disgrace to the kings of the Ikshvaku dynasty.
